search_text: published ZDI-09-016 ZDI-CAN-397 Novell Client/NetIdentity Agent Remote Arbitrary Pointer Dereference Code Execution Vulnerability 2009-04-06 CVE-2009-1350 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-1350 ['Novell'] ['Netware'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell Netware. A valid IPC$ connection must be established in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within xtagent.exe during the handling of RPC messages over the XTIERRPCPIPE named pipe. Insufficient sanity checking allows remote attackers to dereference an arbitrary pointer which can be leveraged to execute code under the context of the system user. Novell has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
